note: One complete-article measurement, independent of target count. Four provisional 0–100 routing scores; characters establish entity relevance and supported facts from the full source. Thresholds favor fewer character reviews and are not calibrated accuracy claims.

journalist.instructions: Does this article contain substantive sports news or analysis?

influencer.instructions: Does this article express emotion, such as hope, anger, joy, worry, relief or frustration?

scout.instructions: Does this article discuss current player availability, injury, fitness, suspension, transfer or trade news?

insider.instructions: Does this article discuss transfers, trades, signings, departures or coaching changes?

scout.note: Nomination only; Scout still requires an applied source-linked structured record.
